about: Retrieval evaluation set. Questions written by the project owner (with deliberate typos); labels reviewed by them. For each collection: a list of acceptable ids (the top result must be one of them; "none" in the list means returning nothing is also acceptable), [] = search must return nothing, null = not scored for this collection.
